full_prompt_en: A square, low-key photographic image shows a young woman leaning close to a dense cluster of flowers, her face turned downward in soft three-quarter view. Nearly black shadow fills the left edge and the space behind her head, so her dark hair blends into the background. A few pale blossoms and small reddish seed clusters are woven into the hair near the upper edge. Her forehead and cheek occupy the center of the frame. The visible eyes look downward, their lids and lashes lit by a narrow, gentle highlight. A warm line of light follows the bridge of her nose, and her lips are partly hidden behind a pale flower and dark green leaves at the lower center. Her skin is softly rendered in muted peach, olive-brown shadow, and cream highlights rather than a bright, even complexion. At the lower left, a small fold of pale clothing enters the frame, but most of the body is concealed by darkness and vegetation. The flowers form a textured foreground running from the lower middle to the right edge: tiny white clustered heads, soft cream petals, dusky yellow blooms, and rounded green leaves overlap at different depths. Some blossoms are sharply visible near her nose, while closer stems blur into soft pale shapes and others dissolve into the black at the right. There is no defined room, horizon, or object beyond the face and plants. The tight crop makes their proximity and the quiet downward gaze the main spatial relationship. Fine photographic grain and faint softness give the surfaces an aged, tactile quality. The light seems to come from the upper right and slightly in front, touching the forehead, eyelids, cheek, flower tips, and a few leaves while leaving the far hair and background almost black. The shadows remain deep but gradual, and no hard cast pattern crosses the face. The overall composition is intimate and hushed, balancing a warm half-lit face against cool green foliage and scattered cream flowers within a dark, enveloping field.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形低调摄影图像呈现一位年轻女子贴近浓密花束，面部以柔和的四分之三视角向下。近黑阴影填满左边缘和她头后的空间，使深色头发融入背景。上边缘附近，几朵浅色小花和红褐色小籽穗编在头发里。额头和面颊占据画面中央。可见的双眼向下看，眼睑和睫毛被一道窄而柔的亮光照到。一线暖光沿鼻梁延伸，嘴唇则部分被下方中央的浅色花与深绿叶遮住。皮肤由低调的桃色、橄榄褐阴影与奶油色高光柔和塑形，而非明亮均匀的肤色。左下方，一点浅色衣服的褶面进入画框，但身体大多被黑暗与植物遮住。花朵形成从下方中央延向右边缘的有肌理前景：细小白色簇花、柔软奶油色花瓣、灰黄色花朵与圆润绿叶在不同深度重叠。靠近鼻子的部分花清楚可见，更近的花茎化成柔浅形状，另一些则消失在右侧黑色里。脸和植物以外，没有明确房间、地平线或其他物件。紧密裁切让二者的距离与安静的垂眸成为主要空间关系。细微摄影颗粒和轻微柔化使表面带有陈旧的触感。光似乎从右上稍前方照来，触及额头、眼睑、面颊、花尖和少数叶片，让远侧头发与背景近乎漆黑。阴影深却渐进，脸上没有硬质投影图案。整体构图亲密静谧，以暖调半亮的脸平衡冷绿叶丛和散落奶油色花朵，并将它们包裹在深暗色域内。
style_prompt_en: The low-key photographic treatment lets a few softly illuminated planes emerge from a nearly black field. Warm peach and olive-brown tones meet cool desaturated greens, while small cream highlights make a broken visual trail. Depth is shallow: selected near surfaces and fine details remain legible, but neighboring layers blur or disappear into shadow. Directional light arrives gently from above and one side, grazing raised textures without producing theatrical hard edges. Fine grain and muted contrast within the lit areas give the image an aged, tactile softness. Organic overlap fills much of the frame, yet the darkest spaces remain generous and quiet. The overall effect is delicate, secretive, and contemplative, with selective visibility and close tonal harmony carrying the mood.
style_prompt_zh: 这种低调摄影处理让少量被柔光照亮的平面从近黑底色中浮现。暖桃色与橄榄褐碰上低饱和冷绿，少数奶油色高光组成断续的视觉路径。景深很浅：选定的近处表面与细节仍可辨，相邻层次却模糊或消失在阴影中。定向光从上方一侧温柔抵达，掠过凸起肌理而不产生戏剧化硬边。细颗粒与受光区域内的低调对比赋予图像陈旧的触觉柔感。有机形体的重叠填满画面大部分区域，最深的空隙仍宽裕安静。整体效果细腻、隐秘而沉思，选择性的可见度与接近的色调关系承载气氛。
theme_en: A downward-looking woman surrounded by flowers in deep shadow
theme_zh: 深影中被花朵环绕、垂眸的女子
name: Laura Makabresku
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
